description: This file defines the GuarantorTransactionData class, a data transfer object used within the loan guarantor component of the Finereact project. It encapsulates transaction-related data, including references to on-hold deposit transactions and loan transactions, along with an identifier and reversal flag.

classes.name: GuarantorTransactionData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing a guarantor's transaction, including transaction identifiers, associated deposit hold transactions, loan transactions, and a reversal indicator.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of GuarantorTransactionData with provided transaction details.
